hypotheses.title: Non-Affine Policy-0T Linear-Size Linear-Depth Resolution Simulation Lemma
hypotheses.statement: For every provenance-complete terminating UNSAT execution of the exact no-cache Policy-0T core after affine_answer=None, with m root clauses, r recorded local Resolution events, u propagated-unit assignments, b branch nodes and o opposite-unit conflict events, a mechanical translation emits an ordinary Resolution refutation of size at most m+r+u+b+o and depth at most 2N+2 on N variables.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Every charged Policy-0T core execution of work W yields a Res(⊕) proof of size O(W) and depth O(N), supplying the solver-to-proof bridge required for an asymptotic lifting lower bound.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: prove an explicit event-by-event simulation from the registered non-affine search core to ordinary Resolution without weakening or hidden semantic inference.
hypotheses.next_gate: Obtain independent mathematical review of the structural induction, especially restriction commutation, reverse unit reasons, duplicate residual provenance and the depth recurrence.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H135 upgrades H132/H134 from a finite recursive translator to a universal theorem draft with exact constants S<=m+r+u+b+o and D<=2N+2, backed by differential fuzzing and an independent serialized proof checker.
falsification_conditions: A provenance-complete non-affine Policy-0T trace whose recorded local resolvent cannot be lifted to root-derived parents.
A unit conflict whose implied literals cannot be removed through recorded reasons.
A branch combination requiring weakening rather than Resolution or direct subclause inheritance.
A trace for which emitted proof size exceeds m+r+u+b+o or depth exceeds 2N+2.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H135 concerns one exact no-cache core and remains FORMALIZING until independent proof review; it does not simulate the affine dispatcher, caching or arbitrary SAT algorithms.

hypotheses.title: Uniform MAJ3 Non-Affine Dispatch and Exact Lift-Encoding Lemma
hypotheses.statement: For every degree d>=1 and charge c, the local relation XOR_i MAJ3(block_i)=c is non-affine; therefore the exact current Policy-0T visible-affine detector returns None on every complete MAJ3-lifted Tseitin instance. Moreover the JANUS direct exact-relation CNF is clause-for-clause identical after canonicalization to the standard clause-wise CNF lift used by the registered Res(⊕) lifting theorem.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The hard lifted family enters precisely the H135 non-affine core, and no uncharged proof-complexity encoding translation is required before applying the lifting theorem.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGEBRAIC_BRIDGE: connect the implemented MAJ3 generator and affine dispatcher exactly to the syntax and gadget premise of the external lifting theorem.
hypotheses.next_gate: Independently review the fibre-slice non-affinity proof and the general clausewise-versus-direct encoding identity beyond the exhaustive degree-one-through-four audits.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H136 replaces finite K4/K3,3 observations by a uniform fibre-slice proof and verifies exact clause-set identity with the lifting definition for all constant degrees used by the route.
falsification_conditions: A degree and charge for which parity-of-MAJ3 is affine.
A complete lifted vertex block accepted by the current affine detector.
A canonical clause present in the theorem lift but absent from the JANUS encoding or conversely.
A target graph whose local scopes merge in a way that changes the reconstructed relation.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H136 is tied to the exact current detector and complete local truth-table CNF; stronger semantic detectors or different encodings require new analysis.

hypotheses.title: Exponential Work Lower Bound for the Non-Affine Policy-0T Core
hypotheses.statement: On MAJ3-lifted odd-charge Tseitin CNFs over a fixed constant-degree expander family with base Resolution width w=Omega(n), every terminating execution of the exact non-affine Policy-0T core requires charged work W=2^{Omega(n)}=2^{Omega(L)}, where L is lifted input length. The derivation combines H135 size/depth simulation, H136 exact dispatch/encoding, and the registered 2026 Res(⊕) depth lower bound Omega(w^2/log S).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Policy-0T receives a rigorous infinite-family exponential lower bound, identifying parity-aware dispatch, caching, stronger learning or another proof-theoretic resource as necessary for any successor policy.
